intro.1.en: The mountain village was getting ready for its festival.

intro.2.en: Beyond the gate, a small figure walked toward us.

gate.reminder.en: The shrine is north of the village. I'm counting on you.

gate.halt.en: Halt, traveler. Beyond here lies the fox village.

gate.ask.en: One festival lantern never came back from the north shrine. Will you find it?

gate.thanks.en: I owe you. The shrine is past the village.

gate.later.en: I see. Speak to me if you change your mind.

quest.lantern.shrine.en: Search the north shrine for the lantern

quest.lantern.return.en: Bring the lantern back to the fox
